case.title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG. Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings. Need: 8150 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 45 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200001. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70110.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
sup:70110.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
sup:70110.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

sup:70110.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
sup:70110.body:
Dear Thomas Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your quote; our own data does not support the increase at this level.

We commit to a binding volume of 8150 pieces a year over 12 months, our full need for this part, as in our demand forecast (fc:310010@2026-09).
Your letter (doc:20260911-70110-P01) gives 51 days of notice, while our framework agreement (ctr:4600070110) requires 90 days.
Producer prices DE: basic iron and steel, ferro-alloys (PPI-C241) changed -4.3% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C241@2024-10, idx:PPI-C241@2025-10).
We will pay on the agreed due date; our accounts payable team has this in hand.

We have set out 3 packages below. Each would be an acceptable basis for agreement for us; if none fits, please tell us which term is the hardest for you:
1. EUR 130.67 per unit, new price from 2027-04-01, payment 14 days net
2. EUR 135.12 per unit, new price from 2027-04-01, payment 90 days net
3. EUR 129.44 per unit, new price from 2027-01-01, payment 14 days net

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part? And what would you need from us to move further on the price?

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

sup:70110.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
sup:70110.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
sup:70110.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the index change and volume change and notice period data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. We have carefully verified your data regarding the 90-day notice period and the PPI-C241 index, and we respect the terms of our framework agreement. Building on your third package, we accept the effective date of 1 January 2027 and the 14-day payment terms in recognition of your firm volume commitment. Consequently, we propose a revised price of €133.10 per unit; please note that as a family-run business, we do not disclose internal cost breakdowns. Our costs move with LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351; the figures stay with us. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €139.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. Alternatively, with a price of €133.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

sup:70110.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
sup:70110.body:
Dear Thomas Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your revised offer.

We commit to a binding volume of 8150 pieces a year over 12 months, our full need for this part.
The PPI-D351 index changed -17.1% from 2025-02 to 2026-02 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-02, idx:PPI-D351@2026-02).

Below are 2 packages we could sign. If one term is the obstacle, please name it:
1. EUR 135.12 per unit, new price from 2027-04-01, payment 90 days net
2. EUR 131.36 per unit, new price from 2027-04-01, payment 14 days net

What would you need from us to move further?

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

sup:70110.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
sup:70110.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
sup:70110.body:
Guten Tag,

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. Building on your second package, we accept the 1 April 2027 effective date and the 14-day payment terms. We can accept your terms and await your order. Our Angebot stands at a price of €131.36 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
